name: Widescreen
summary: See more of the track: 16:10, 16:9 or 21:9 instead of the DS's 4:3, and a Combined layout that shows the whole game as one widescreen picture.
description:
Draws the 3D screen wider, so the view extends to the left and right at the same height (no stretching, no zoom). The game already computes the scenery beyond the DS's screen edges; the GPU renderer now keeps it.

Choose the shape in the in-game menu (F10, Display tab) or with `Widescreen = 16:9` in settings.txt: Off, 16:10, 16:9 or 21:9. For a full-width TV picture, also turn on Single screen. The touch screen keeps its 4:3 picture, centred.

Map overlay (1.1): show the touch screen (race positions and map) small in the bottom-right corner of the 3D screen, so you can play on one widescreen screen. Turn it on in F10 or press F9; size and opacity are adjustable.

Track style (new in 1.2): only the course map's track outline, the racers' heads and the timer, floating over the 3D view with the background left out. In 1.3 the touch screen is kept on the game's whole-course map while this style shows, and the positions list is left out (clicking the overlay taps the touch screen). F9 cycles Off, Picture and Track.

Combined layout (new in 1.3): the whole game in one widescreen picture, no separate touch screen. Each menu is rearranged from the game's own art: the title bar across the top, the preview and the touch screen's buttons side by side over the menu's live background, with soft edges. Races fill the screen with the map in the corner (F9 switches Picture and Track); results show the race and the standings side by side. Arrangements slide into each other when the scene changes. Click the touch-screen part with the mouse as usual. Choose Screen layout: Combined in F10 or `Layout = Combined` in settings.txt (16:9 unless another Widescreen shape is chosen).

Known limits: the game hides some objects (karts, items, scenery props) when they leave its own 4:3 view, so they may appear late at the far edges. The HUD and menus stay 4:3 in the middle. Needs the GPU renderer (the Combined layout falls back to Stacked without it).
